races.title: Midnite A Next Generation Betting App Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict: A case can be made for a few of these but ALWAYS HAPPY shaped well when runner-up at Southwell after an absence last time and can go one better with this first attempt beyond 1m also looking a plus. The consistent Borjina heads the list of dangers off a handy-looking mark, while Arbaawy , Triple Force and Tropical Sands also need factoring in. ALWAYS HAPPY (IRE) BORJINA ARBAAWY

races.verdict: The market should reveal plenty but the vote goes to the Gosdens' Saxon Warrior newcomer ST EDMUND who is bred to be well above average and can thwart form pick Grinanbearit who could have to settle for runner-up spot again. races.title: AW Trials Day - Lingfield 2nd Jan 2027 Handicap
races.verdict: YIMMNA advanced her form on her first foray into handicap company when a clear runner-up at Southwell and looks the way to go off just a 1 lb higher mark here. races.title: Midnite: Built For 2026 Not 2006 Handicap
races.verdict: A wide-open sprint handicap with the narrow vote in favour of KING'S CROWN . He needs to dispel a lesser effort here 3 weeks ago but tasted success twice from much higher marks over C&D last winter and this is his easiest assignment for some time. Dc Cogent is another to note on the back of a short break, with Woolridge and Shatin Venture completing the shortlist. KING'S CROWN (IRE) DC COGENT WOOLRIDGE
